Name: Stardew Valley Aquariums
Author: nocontribution
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Just thought it would be a good idea to make. I enjoy using fish ponds as income generators and I included the mechanics I believe Fish Ponds should have by default.[/color]


[size=4][b]Main features:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Fish retain quality. Newly spawned fish have a chance to reproduce from each existing fish, inheriting its quality with a 5% chance to increase quality 1 stage if not already iridium.
• Roe produced uses the same logic without the chance to increase quality. Items not roe do not gain quality.
• Spawn times, Population values, items produced, quantity produced, population "quests", movement styles and anything else are all derived from each fish. Populations are limited by Aquarium size though.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Items produced will stack indefinitely and appear in the fish tank until collected.
• Golden Animal Crackers work. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Water tinting based on fish species is implemented but it is not as dramatic due to maintaining translucence.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Recipes sold by Willy at fishing levels 2, 4, 6 and 8.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Crafted with existing Fish Tanks and a relative amount of stone, seaweed and green algae.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Interact with Aquarium with a fishing rod selected to remove fish one at a time. They will be removed in order of lowest quality. Removing the last fish will reset the Aquarium.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI
[/color][/size]Content Patcher

[size=4][b]Disclaimers:[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is my first mod.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]I am a very inexperienced programmer. I have never used C#. Basically all of the mod was written with AI assistance. There is a very good possibility that things could have been done more efficiently than how I accomplished them.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The recipes, particularly the larger tanks, do not work well in the crafting menu.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The only bug I have experience is the Cave Jelly sprite produced from Lava Eels appears as a bobber for some reason.  I only tested around 10 different fish so there is the possibility of others. I tested 1 RSV fish. I don't see how any other expansion fish would work differently.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]I don't know how Alternative Textures would work with the mod. I had to implement a unique drawing method for drawing both layers of the fish tanks because it is a furniture item and not a fishtank item. I will likely just update the tilesheet for myself in a playthrough if I find a texture I'd prefer. Feel free to try and let me know though, but I am not active on this site.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]I guess shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ncarigon?gameId=1303]ncarigon[/url] for making most of my favorite mods.[/color]
